mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.created_time DESC
SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.created_time DESC
SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY p.created_time DESC
SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.created_time DESC

SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name, (CASE WHEN p.name = #{keyword} THEN 100 WHEN p.name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 80 WHEN p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 60 WHEN p.brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 40 WHEN c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 30 WHEN p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (p.sales_count * 0.05) + (p.view_count * 0.01) as relevance FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY relevance DESC, p.sales_count DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, stock = #{stock}, category_id = #{categoryId}, merchant_id = #{merchantId}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, images = #{images}, brand = #{brand}, model = #{model}, weight = #{weight}, dimensions = #{dimensions}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET stock = #{stock} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET sales_count = sales_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET stock = GREATEST(0, stock - #{quantity}) WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
